outreach_draft.subject: A thought on your Immigration page
outreach_draft.body:
Olubiyi,

I was looking through Ogundipe Law Group’s site and noticed Personal Injury and Immigration are both handled within the same homepage experience rather than having their own focused client pages.

Those are very different conversations. Someone trying to secure a green card or citizenship, or facing deportation, is arriving with very different questions and priorities from someone coming to the firm after an injury.

A dedicated Immigration page could speak directly to that person, give Google a focused page to crawl and index, and give AI tools clearer context around that part of your practice.

I’m using Immigration as the first mockup because the contrast with Personal Injury makes the idea easy to see while keeping the firm’s current positioning intact.

I’m putting together a quick mockup to show you what I mean. I’ll send it over in the next couple of days.

If you’d rather I didn’t, just let me know.
